# Bundled local OCR

Tesseract.js 6.0.1 and tesseract.js-core 6.0.0 are distributed under Apache-2.0; their license files are included here. The English model is from @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0, 4.0.0_best_int/eng.traineddata.gz, derived from the Apache-2.0 Tesseract language data.

Sources: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js ; https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core ; https://github.com/naptha/tessdata ; https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best

All OCR runtime and English model assets are bundled. No external OCR download or patient image upload is required. Other language models are not included. OCR is a text detector, not a validated medical anonymization engine.
